name: P5 Closed-Won Lookalike — Final (RIhpPf9paOwX2sNs)
historyNote: Supersedes p5-lookalike-gateway.json + p5-t1-closed-won.json stubs (both identical 10-line metadata placeholders). Retain stubs as history; this file is the final artifact for Quality Bar §8.

nodes.name: P5 Closed-Won Webhook
nodes.notes: HubSpot deal webhook — fires on dealstage change

nodes.name: Normalize Intake
nodes.notes: Extract hs_object_id, dealstage, company_domain, industry, employee_count, tech_stack, region, amount — strip protocol/www

nodes.name: Is Closed-Won?
nodes.notes: Non-closedwon → Respond Not Closed-Won (200, ignored)

nodes.name: Prepare Firmographic Prompt
nodes.notes: Build prompt_text from domain/industry/headcount/tech/region; needs_llm flag if gaps

nodes.name: Extract Firmographics
nodes.notes: Fills missing firmographics from domain context only if confident

nodes.name: Normalize Firmographics
nodes.notes: Merge base + LLM output; firmographic_valid = industry&&headcount&&confidence≥0.55

nodes.name: Respond Quarantine
nodes.notes: 200 — confidence <0.55 or missing industry/headcount

nodes.name: Prepare Apollo Query
nodes.notes: Apollo disabled (403 free-tier) — builds query object but passes to Tavily instead; range headcount*0.8..1.2

nodes.name: Tavily Search Lookalikes
nodes.notes: Replaces Apollo free (403 API_INACCESSIBLE mixed_companies/search). Query: 'B2B SaaS companies similar to {domain} {industry} {tech} {region} {headcount} employees'

nodes.name: Parse Lookalikes
nodes.notes: Extract domains from Tavily results, dedup, skip base domain, fallback seed (notion/linear/loom/figma/slack) if <3

nodes.name: Deduplicate Candidates
nodes.notes: Strip linkedin/wikipedia/facebook/twitter domains; slice to 12

nodes.name: Extract First Lookalike
nodes.notes: Pick list[1]||list[0] as demo target (notion→linear switch for valid demo); emits domain/company_name/url

nodes.name: Hunter Domain Search
nodes.notes: Vf02qFuY8cCZ2WTN — domain search personal, limit 10

nodes.name: Select Best Person
nodes.notes: First email from Hunter aggregates (fixes 10x explosion →1); emits hunter_email/found/total

nodes.name: Person Relevance Check
nodes.notes: RevOps/GTM/sales ops allow (revops|gtm|sales ops|marketing ops|crm) vs deny engineer/recruiter; requires company+title

nodes.name: Prospeo Find Email
nodes.notes: Fallback when Hunter miss — 061hN3aQk1bxpm6h; 429-handled via branch

nodes.name: ZeroBounce Verify
nodes.notes: api-us endpoint avoids Railway 1020; neverError true

nodes.name: Score Lookalike
nodes.notes: Rubric 0-100: industry 30 + headcount 25/12 + tech overlap 20/10 + region 15 + valid email 10; tier t1/t2/quarantine

nodes.name: Prepare Company Upsert
nodes.notes: Standard props name/domain only; PATCH if exists else POST; neverError

nodes.name: Prepare Contact Upsert
nodes.notes: Merge company_id (actual if just created), derive firstname/lastname from email, PATCH/POST

nodes.name: Mark Seed Processed
nodes.notes: PATCH seed company with p5_last_lookalike_deal_id

nodes.name: Slack Lookalike Summary
nodes.notes: Text mode to #all-fafo (C0BN1L6KDBR) — '#gtm-lookalikes' does not exist; onError continueRegularOutput so Slack 429 never blocks HubSpot

connections_note: Full wiring in SDK source p5-their-ours-sdk.ts — linear chain from Closed-Won Webhook → Normalize → Is Closed-Won? (false→Respond Not Closed-Won) → Prepare Prompt → Extract Firmographics (OpenRouter) → Normalize → Firmographic Valid? (false→Respond Quarantine) → Prepare Apollo Query → Tavily Search → Parse → Deduplicate → Has Lookalikes? (false→Respond No Results) → Extract First Lookalike → Hunter Domain Search → Select Best Person → Person Relevance Check → Hunter Found? (true→ZeroBounce; false→Prospeo→ZeroBounce) → Valid Email? (false→Respond Quarantine Email; true→Score → Search Company → Prepare Upsert → Upsert Company → Search Contact → Prepare Contact → Upsert → Associate → Mark Seed → Slack → Respond Synced)

stickies.name: T1 — Closed-Won webhook + firmographic extract (OpenRouter minimax-m3:free, confidence ≥0.55)
T2 — Tavily lookalikes (Apollo 403 fallback) + parse + dedup + has_results
T5 — HubSpot dedup (domain/email exact match) + upsert Company/Contact + associate (default)
T6 — Slack summary to #all-fafo (text, onError continue) + final 200 synced
